evidence.quote: NEW - The next generation MatriXX detector offering unrivaled resolution and workflow efficiency.
Our newest solution for depth dose measurements, the Blue Phantom PT, is specifically designed for Proton Therapy (PT) Pencil Beam Scanning (PBS).
The newest solution for daily QA
"myQA Daily has really simplified our linac morning QA process and workflow, and we are now able to save QA time every day compared to our previous solution”
myQA SRS now also available for use with CyberKnife®
The new myQA SRS solution uniquely combines:
New: support of SRS and SBRT Patient QA with the myQA SRS film-class detector
Now fully compatible with your Varian Halcyon® and Ethos™ treatment machines
providing high quality dosimetry equipment and services to more than 4,000 satisfied water phantom users worldwide.
